sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items:
AC
 Multi-amp model MS-2-E .

Timer
 model MCS-5N .
Avometer
Test leads .
Spray .
Burnisher

sections.text: Work to be carried out

Disconnect the terminals of the relay and
get it out of the panel .
Clean the relay using a spray .
Clean contacts of the relay using contact burnisher .
Connect the relay coil terminals ( 8 , 9 ) to the multi-amp output .
Connect the relay contact terminals ( 1 , 10 ) to the timer .

Adjust the multi-amp output at 200% of
relay current tap and record the tripping time .

repeat step no.
6 at (300% , 400%) of relay current tap .
Record these values on the test sheet .

Connect the relay terminals again and
connect DC power supply .
Make jumper on terminals (1 , 10) to insure relay operation .

Check that the indicator target of the
lock-out relay is dropped .
